title: Diffusion models for the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model
abstract: arXiv:2610.39568v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A score-based diffusion model is trained on the two-dimensional classical Heisenberg model, the lattice representation of the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model. Neural networks are trained on three different coarse-grainings of the same training set to implement a multiscale sampling scheme that modestly improves both the accuracy and computational cost of direct sampling on the finest lattice. Stein (or Schwinger-Dyson) diagnostics for the two-point correlation function are introduced to assess the quality of the learned score without relying on reverse diffusion sampling. These diagnostics are also incorporated into an additional training loss. We discuss several technical considerations relevant to implementing diffusion models on $S^2$. translated_title: O(3) 非线性西格玛模型的扩散模型
translated_abstract: 基于分数（score-based）的扩散模型在二维经典海森堡模型上进行训练，该模型是 O(3) 非线性西格玛模型的格点表示。神经网络在同一样本集的三种不同粗粒化版本上进行训练，以实现一种多尺度采样方案，该方案适度地提高了在最细格点上直接采样的精度并降低了其计算成本。针对两点关联函数引入了 Stein（即 Schwinger-Dyson）诊断方法，以便在不依赖反向扩散采样的情况下评估所学到的分数函数的质量。这些诊断方法还被纳入一个额外的训练损失中。我们讨论了在 S² 上实现扩散模型的若干相关技术问题，包括考虑将网络输入提升至 S³（类似于 CP¹ 表示中的做法），以及为短时球面热核开发一种边界层近似……
tldr: 该论文在 O(3) 非线性西格玛模型的格点表示（二维海森堡模型）上训练基于分数的扩散模型，通过多尺度粗粒化采样方案适度提升了直接采样的精度与计算效率，并引入 Stein/Schwinger-Dyson 诊断方法，既可在不依赖反向扩散采样的情况下评估学到的分数质量，又可作为额外训练损失加以利用。
en_tdlr: This paper trains score-based diffusion models on the lattice representation of the O(3) nonlinear sigma model, implements a multiscale coarse-grained sampling scheme that modestly improves direct sampling accuracy and computational cost, and introduces Stein (Schwinger-Dyson) diagnostics to assess the learned score without reverse diffusion sampling and to augment the training loss.
